description: A false-colour satellite image shows a large, dark blue body of water, likely a lake or lagoon, centrally located. The surrounding terrestrial landscape exhibits a mosaic of diverse land cover / land use (LULC) patterns. Various shades of reddish-brown, green, and light yellow-orange denote different types of vegetation, bare soil, or agricultural fields. Some areas display distinct, small, rectangular parcels, characteristic of intensively managed agriculture, while others are larger and less geometrically regular, suggesting natural vegetation or less intensive practices. Small, indistinct grey or white patches visible at lower resolution may represent urban or built-up areas, particularly along the southern shore of the lake. Three prominent yellow arrows highlight specific areas: one points to a patch of varied reddish-brown and green parcels on the western side of the lake, another to similar patterns on the north-eastern side, and a third to a mix of reddish-brown and lighter green/yellow parcels on the southern side. A faint red outline is visible around a parcel in the top-right corner. No scale bar, compass, legend, or reference year is present in the image.
